show_hn.title: Show HN: Noti – Notes and reminders that live in your notification center

quotes.text:
I made a dead simple and ultralight iOS app that lets you send quick notes or reminders to yourself as instant notifications. It is so minimal that your notes aren’t even saved in-app, they exist only as notifications.

This isn’t meant to replace heavyweight tools like Todoist, but instead to complement them. I still use Todoist for big projects and deadlines, but I find that smaller, ephemeral tasks benefit from a different paradigm.

Sometimes I need a lightweight, persistent reminder without managing due dates, priorities, and inboxes.

Sometimes I just want to jot something down and not forget about it immediately.

There’s no sign-up, no scheduling, and no payment. Just type, hit submit, and the message instantly appears in your notification center. That’s it.

Would love any feedback!
